title: Keemat: They Are Back
desc: Two crooks accidentally kill a man and decide to inform his parents about the bad news. However, once they meet the family, they end up lying to them.

title: Vijaypath
desc: When a criminal is sentenced to death by Judge Saxena, the gangster's brother takes revenge by killing the judge's family and his driver. Later, the driver's son embarks on a vengeful quest.

title: Sirf Tum
desc: Deepak and Aarti fall in love with each other without ever meeting each other. Later, Aarti sets out to look for him in the city of Delhi.

title: Krishna
desc: The life of Sunil, an aspiring pilot, takes a disastrous turn when he is falsely convicted for a crime he did not commit.

title: Saugandh
desc: Sarang, an evil landlord, kills Ganga's family. Years later, Shiva, Ganga's son, marries Chand, Sarang's daughter, to seek revenge from Sarang by destroying his ego.
